common.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Try again; if it keeps happening, contact your platform owner.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Use the email address your organization invited.
signIn.invalid: That email and password don't match an account. Check both and try again.
signIn.locked: Too many attempts. Sign-in for this email is paused; try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
signIn.inviteOnly: NEXORA accounts are created by invitation. If you need access, ask your organization's owner or admin.
signIn.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.

invite.title: Accept your invitation
invite.missing: This page needs the link from your invitation email. Open the email and select the link again.
invite.invalid: This invitation link isn't valid. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.
invite.used: This invitation has already been used or replaced by a newer one. Sign in, or ask for a new invitation.
invite.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.
invite.newAccount: Create your password to join. You'll use it with this email to sign in.
invite.existingAccount: Already have a NEXORA account with this email? Enter its password to join.
invite.name: Your name
invite.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A short sentence works well.
invite.wrongPassword: That password doesn't match the account for this email.
invite.otherAccount: You're signed in with a different account. Sign out, then open the invitation link again.
invite.locked: Too many attempts for this email. Try again in 15 minutes.
